probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein said desiccant is __selected to inhibit decomposition of the fuel and increase thermal stability of the composition__.

2. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, __and wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide__.

3. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, __wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide__.

4. (Original) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition.

5. (Original) The gas generator of claim 4 wherein said extrusion aid is selected from graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof.

6. (Original) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate.

7. (Original) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof.

8. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is __a racemic mixture of tartaric acid__.

9. (Currently Amended) A gas generating system comprising: a gas generator comprising a composition, said composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and said composition further containing a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein said desiccant is __selected to inhibit decomposition of the fuel and increase thermal stability of the composition__.

10. (Currently Amended) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, __and wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide__.

11. (Currently Amended) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, __and wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide__.

12. (Original) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said system is a vehicle occupant protection system.

13. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition, wherein said desiccant is __selected to inhibit decomposition of the fuel and increase thermal stability of the composition__.

14. (Original) The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof.

15. (Original) The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate.

16. (Original) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide.

17. (Original) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is zeolite.

18. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is __zeolite__ selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours.
